events.name: Easy Endurance 75
events.notes: Easy ride after low recovery, HR stayed under 135 bpm.

events.name: VO2max 5×3
events.notes: All five reps held at 134 W. About 12 min counted in Z4-5, so the next VO2max sets use 4-minute reps.

events.name: VO2max 5×4 + Endurance
events.notes: 5 × 4 min at 108% FTP with equal easy spinning between. Hard but even: the last rep should match the first, with HR reaching about 158+ bpm by the end. If you cannot hold a rep, drop 3% for the rest of the set instead of stopping. Then settle into steady zone 2. Short on time? Cut the endurance, not the main set.

events.name: Endurance 105
events.notes: Steady zone 2 with short tempo lifts to stay engaged. Conversational throughout, and HR should stay near or below 135 bpm outside the lifts. Ease off if it drifts higher.

events.name: VO2max 5×4 + Endurance
events.notes: 5 × 4 min at 108% FTP with equal easy spinning between. Hard but even: the last rep should match the first, with HR reaching about 158+ bpm by the end. If you cannot hold a rep, drop 3% for the rest of the set instead of stopping. Then settle into steady zone 2. Short on time? Cut the endurance, not the main set.

events.name: Sweet Spot 3×12 + Endurance
events.notes: 3 × 12 min at 90% FTP. Comfortably hard: full sentences are a struggle, but you could keep going. This is the main FTP builder, so keep the power steady. Then settle into steady zone 2. Short on time? Cut the endurance, not the sweet spot.

events.name: Recovery Threshold 3×6
events.notes: Lighter week. Controlled threshold work keeps your zone 4-5 minutes on target without digging a hole. Stop feeling fresh.

events.name: Easy Endurance 75
events.notes: Lighter week. Easy and relaxed: finish wanting more.

events.name: Ramp Test
events.notes: Come in rested and ride to failure. New FTP = 75% of your best 1-minute power. Zwift's built-in Ramp Test works too. Update FTP in both Zwift and Intervals.icu afterwards, or workout targets will differ between them. Stop immediately if you feel unwell.
